It is essential that the court before taking account of prevalence:
• has supporting evidence from an external source, for example, Community Impact Statements, to
justify claims that a particular crime is prevalent in their area, and is causing particular harm in that
community, and
• is satisfied that there is a compelling need to treat the offence more seriously than elsewhere.
